event_text: Rakuten Securities says information in its test environment may have leaked on this date (as found later)
Rakuten Securities detects possible unauthorized access, blocks the affected access and makes fixes
Rakuten Securities publishes its apology and notice: up to about 4.47 million and 11.25 million accounts affected
notes: Date only, Japan time. Counts in c003 and c004.

event_text: Japan's Financial Services Agency orders Rakuten Securities to report; the company announces it
Nippon TV reports the financial services minister confirmed the order
notes: Time is the outlet's last-updated time.

event_text: The Japan Times (Jiji) reports the company says it used real customer data in the test environment, postpones a planned Tokyo store opening and waives some transfer fees
notes: Date only, Japan time; date of the report.

event_text: The Japan Times reports at least 15,000 people registered interest in a possible class action
notes: Date only, Japan time; date of the report.

event_text: ITmedia NEWS reports the company told it the real customer data copied to the test server was not masked and that an attacker exploited a vulnerability
notes: Time is the outlet's published time. Tokyo Shimbun later reports masking is under investigation.

event_text: ITmedia NEWS reports the financial services minister said the agency is working closely with the police and Japan's National Cybersecurity Office on the incident
notes: Date only, Japan time; the outlet says the comments came at a morning press conference.
